title: Fixed-component compatibility with derived unit
statement: For commutative rings A,B, φ:B→A and i∈ℤ with the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], let epsilon be affineDerivedPushforwardSheafEdge_canonical [def-pc-affine-derived-pushforward-sheaf-edge-canonical]. For each additive exact quasi-coherent-valued functor F from A-modules to module sheaves on Spec A with f_*F exact, and each complex C with Q(FC) quasi-coherent, f_* of the inverse exact-homology and localization/homology comparisons followed by epsilon at Q(FC) equals the inverse exact-homology and localization/homology comparisons for f_*F followed by homology of the actual right-derived unit at FC. No arbitrary transformation parameter is present.

source.place: 0AVW, proof, cohomology display; 08D4, bound-one truncation comparison, applied on inverse images of affine opens.

proof.text: Apply the reverse-unit comparison to D=F C. Use the proved exact-family reverse homology comparison to identify its source after cancelling the localization/homology isomorphisms.

Postcompose the required equality with the invertible reverse comparison, cancel the canonical edge with its inverse, and use functoriality and associativity. This is the proved cancellation calculation in the component theorem.
